en.summary: Public support for the energy transition is generally high in Switzerland. Yet many renewable energy projects still face delays, opposition, or implementation challenges at the local level. What makes the difference?
en.image_alt: Webinar | Enabling Renewable Energy: The Role of Local Engagement and Social Dynamics
en.body:
Public support for the energy transition is generally high in Switzerland. Yet many renewable energy projects still face delays, opposition, or implementation challenges at the local level. What makes the difference?

Join researchers and practitioners to explore how trust, participation, local leadership, and governance shape the acceptance of renewable energy projects.

📅 **8 June 2026** │ 🕐 **11:30–12:45** │ 💬 **English**

**11:30–11:35** | Welcome & Context

**11:35–11:55** | Research Perspective: Perceptions & Trade-offs  
(Simon Montfort, EPFL)

**11:55–12:15** | From Public Support to Project Approval  
(Jonas Schmid, University of Bern)

**12:15–12:30** | Living Lab Perspective: Engagement in Practice  
(Evelyn Lobsiger-Kägi, SWICE Lokstadt Living Lab)

**12:30–12:45** | Panel Q&A  
Moderator: Isabelle Stadelmann-Steffen

👉 **Key topics**

\- Social acceptance & local engagement

\- Participation, trust & transparency

\- Swiss case studies & Living Lab experiences

\- Practical insights for policymakers, utilities, and project developers
